faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Madras University Guest Lecturer (Full-Time) position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Guest Lecturer (Full-Time) post at Madras University is 14th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned department before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Physics, Chemistry, Photonics, or Biophotonics with a NET/SLET qualification or a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline. Knowledge in specific areas like Chemical Biology is also desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Guest Lecturer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Guest Lecturer (Full-Time) position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by Madras University.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline. You will need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Guest Lecturer (Full-Time) at Madras University as per the released notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an application screening. Candidates whose applications are shortlisted will be further considered for the role.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Guest Lecturer position?
faq.answer: The Guest Lecturer (Full-Time) position at Madras University is a contractual job, meaning it is offered for a fixed tenure.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Madras University located?
faq.answer: Madras University is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600113.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can typically be downloaded from the official website of Madras University. Links for these are provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
